name: COMP_007
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (44%)** · Ambiguous: Invasive vs Benign · Careful review
Tier 1 frozen section cannot separate Invasive (44%) from Benign (40%) [F1] and flags lateral margin [F7].

## Confidence
|Signal|Value|Reading|
|---|---|---|
|Top probabilities|Invasive 44%, Benign 40%, InSitu 15%, Normal 0%|Invasive and Benign nearly tied|
|Conformal set|Benign, Invasive (90% target, alpha 0.1)|Benign not excluded at 90%|
|Reliability / OOD|96% reliability, 94% OOD, 12/12 tiles [F6]|Unflagged input, high OOD shift|
|CONCH–MUSK agreement|Agree on top class|Both backbones match top call|
|Similar cases|5/5 Invasive (85%–89%); contrast InSitu (85%) [F5]|All nearest neighbors Invasive|

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 5, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · High score (+1.24), strongest invasive signal [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Low score (+0.55); scarcity favors invasion [F3] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 5, 7) · context · High lymphocyte score (−0.49) [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Low score (+0.47); scarcity favors invasion · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 3, 5, 7) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.40), 0/20 spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive score beyond random (0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unverified (0.0008, 95% CI −0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); uses Unreliable normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Benign lesion, lymphocytes (regions 5, 7), or composite frozen-section artifact mimics invasion (Benign 40%).
- Atypia is duct-confined (region 0) like contrast case BACH_0063 (InSitu, 85% match), with 94% OOD shift.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 9, 10, 11**: Verify stromal invasion (100% risk in 9, 10) versus lymphocytes.
2. **Regions 7, 11**: Inspect lateral margin (108 um at x=1792, y=768); frozen-section stains blocked.
3. **Regions 0–3, 8**: Compare low-risk upper regions (duct-confined region 0) and benign stroma (region 8).
